errors.text: The proposed 1300 °C cycle does not reconstruct the required 1400 °C, 18 h vacuum sintering followed by quenching from 1500 °C.
The predicted grain size of less than 10 µm conflicts with the target result of 33 ± 19 µm.
The hypothesis seeks near-total oxygen removal, whereas the target process retains approximately 1 wt.% oxygen for interstitial strengthening and phase control.
